name: M-Bench-Games
description: M-Bench-Games evaluates models on game-related language tasks, measuring their ability to understand game descriptions, generate strategies, and answer game-specific questions. It covers a variety of prompt types drawn from gaming contexts to probe reasoning, planning, and domain-specific knowledge. The benchmark is intended to gauge practical model behavior rather than low-level control or vision-based gameplay.
reputation: A niche benchmark with limited community adoption, used primarily by researchers studying model behavior on game-related language tasks.
